definitions.correct_fraction: fraction of originally blank cells whose top prediction equals the answer
definitions.remaining_incorrect_fraction: one minus correct_fraction; it contains the same information with opposite sign
definitions.first_solve_progress: zero for puzzles never solved through 1024; otherwise min(iteration / first_solve_iteration, 1)
definitions.stable_solved_duration: log-scaled number of consecutive exactly solved integer iterations ending at the snapshot
definitions.shared_coordinate: rank-one ridge regression from a board-level hidden-state summary to the three standardized progress targets
definitions.selection_score: mean of the three mean within-puzzle Spearman correlations
definitions.fitting: projection and normalization fit on discovery puzzles only; representation and ridge selected on validation; final puzzles used once
